title: Japanese Beef Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful Japanese-inspired beef stew made with tender beef and rich beef broth. Serve over steamed rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add hot sauce. Cook for 1 minute.
Add soy sauce, sugar, and 2 cups of beef broth. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.
Stir in ukrainian sour cream and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.
